description: Manual resolutions for strand-ambiguous or study-encoded production loci. Each entry is tied to the rule's cited direct study.

rs495828.rationale: UCSC hg19 dbSNP151 independently places rs495828 on the positive strand at chr9:136154867 with G/T alleles; the current Ensembl GRCh37 endpoint omits this historical placement.

rs11803731.rationale: The cited association reports rs11803731-A and its reported frequency matches the GRCh38 forward A allele.

rs11855415.rationale: The cited association reports rs11855415-A; Ensembl maps the reviewed locus to forward A/T.

rs12325817.rationale: The PEMT -744 G>C study nomenclature and forward C/G mapping support C as the higher-requirement allele; the prior synthetic C/T pair was invalid.

rs12696304.rationale: The cited telomere-length association and committed forward C/G mapping report G as the decreasing allele.

rs12931267.rationale: The cited hair-color association and GRCh38 forward C/G mapping report G as the effect allele.

rs12934922.rationale: The BCMO1 study directly reports the rs12934922 A/T conversion association; A is retained as the higher-conversion allele.

rs1362756.rationale: The cited optic-disc association and Ensembl strand=1 C/G mapping report C as the increasing allele.

rs1537415.rationale: The cited periodontitis association reports rs1537415-G on the reviewed forward C/G locus.

rs16891982.rationale: The cited pigmentation association reports rs16891982-C on the reviewed forward C/G locus.

rs1799750.rationale: The MMP1 1G/2G promoter polymorphism is represented by the input platforms as D/I; the prior synthetic A/G formula was invalid.

rs1799752.rationale: The ACE insertion/deletion study and vendor encoding directly use D/I genotypes.

rs1799945.rationale: HFE H63D is the directly reviewed C/G locus; G is the effect allele used by the transparent rule.

rs1801198.rationale: The TCN2 C776G study nomenclature supports the reviewed C/G mapping and G effect allele.

rs1830084.rationale: The cited transferrin association reports rs1830084-A; the prior synthetic A/G pair was invalid.

rs4950928.rationale: The cited YKL-40 association reports G on the reviewed forward C/G locus.

rs6573416.rationale: The cited self-rated-health association reports G on the reviewed forward C/G locus.

rs713598.rationale: The direct G145C TAS2R38 study identifies C as the higher-sensitivity allele.

rs964184.rationale: The cited vitamin-E association and GRCh38 forward C/G mapping report G as the increasing allele; the prior G/T pair was invalid.
